sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Officer Philip W. S. Craig worked for the American Fork Police Department from May 1, 2018, through October 2, 2021. He left the department approximately five months after the April 23, 2021, Janene Thorpe encounter. The Thorpes later named Craig as a defendant in a federal lawsuit filed in April 2023.
Craig began working for the Utah County Sheriff’s Office in October 2021. Public compensation records from 2022 through 2025 indicate that he continued working there through at least 2025.

sections.title: Related Police Encounters
descriptions: Officer Philip W. S. Craig was involved in the Janene Thorpe encounter alongside Officer Christopher Slate Blackburn. Craig was named as a defendant in the civil lawsuit subsequently filed by the Thorpes.

The folder below contains links to YouTube videos showing body-camera footage of the encounter, documents from the Thorpes’ lawsuit, and records from related civil cases involving the Thorpes and their neighbors.
